about_the_game:
Another action-packed crime romp from the infamous PAKO series!

PAKO 4 is an atmospheric and violent indie action game where the player causes chaos in a big city by committing various crimes with his accomplice and escaping the police. The game is shot from a third-person view and you can move around the city on foot or by car. Fast paced arcade mechanics from Pako 2 meet more in depth missions varying from escorting people to doing all kinds of hi-jinx around the North Paw area! Come and enjoy the old school feel of doing crimes!

Key features:

  • Single-player action game: drive and walk freely around in the city

  • Complete various missions, such as bank robberies

  • Retro inspired graphics of the early 2000 games we all loved!

  • Work together with a npc buddy

  • If your car breaks down, keep escaping on foot and take another: every car is drivable!

  • Shoot twin-stick style and destroy stuff!

  • Different camera angle options

  • In-game radio channels bringing the bangers

  • Take screenshots in Photo Mode

  • More features coming during Early Access!

  • We encourage people to give their feedback, ideas and just generally talk stuff at the Community Hub, we are eager to listen what you are wishing for!
